Thanks for taking this — we're ready to kick off supplier setup for Redwood so we can get the PO and onboarding formalities started. A few items we need to collect to keep our procurement and security review moving: 

- Do you have a signed DPA template or will we need to start a new one? (If you have standard language, please attach.)

- Data retention / deletion policy for customer data and logs (default retention and options for custom retention).

I've attached our vendor intake form to speed things up (Nimbus_Onboarding_Form.pdf). Can you confirm the items above and an expected timeline for PO issuance? We're aiming for contract + PO in the next 10 business days.

Emma / Jasmine — attaching the materials you requested and summarizing the privacy/security positions so your team can circulate internally.

Attachments:
- SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (application/pdf) — redacted to remove customer identifiers.
- redwood_subprocessors_2027Q1.csv (text/csv) — includes subprocessor name, hosting country, and purpose.
- Standard_DPA_2026.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document) — our current DPA template; we typically execute this alongside or shortly after the master agreement.

Key points: 
- DPA: Our template is vendor-neutral; we are generally open to minor redlines related to data retention and breach notification timelines. Material changes to liability, indemnity, or data residency will need legal review and may take longer.
- Subprocessors: We disclose primary subprocessors (cloud hosting, monitoring, analytics). We can provide region-specific details if Nimbus requires an EU-only subprocessor list for EU data.
- Retention: Default operational retention for customer-generated content is 365 days (configurable per contract). Request logs/telemetry are retained for 90 days by default; we offer extended retention packages (12–24 months) for customers with regulatory needs.
- Access & Deletion: Customers can request exports and deletion via support; we include contractual SLAs for deletion where required.

If you need a redline, please send the proposed changes to me and I'll coordinate with Legal.

Marissa Cole
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Marissa / Jasmine — this is perfect, thank you. We received the SOC2 and subprocessors CSV. A couple quick follow-ups for our finance team before we route the PO: 

- Can you confirm Redwood's remit-to address and billing contact (Aditya, can you confirm preferred invoice PDF layout)?
- Standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 45, etc.) and whether Redwood accepts ACH/virtual card.
- Will executing the DPA be required before we issue the PO, or can we exchange PO + DPA concurrently? Our legal prefers DPA signed ahead of PO but can accept PO contingent on signature if needed.

If we can get billing + payment details and the DPA template signature path, we'll prepare the PO. Expect our PO draft in 1–2 business days.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this live.

Emma Walsh
